verdict.rationale: EFTPS publishes fixed processing timelines on its own pages. New enrollments take up to five business days, the PIN arrives by U.S. Mail in five to seven business days, payments must be scheduled by 8 p.m. ET the day before the due date, and funds settle on the date you select. These are static, published service clocks, not current or live processing times broken out per transaction type. missing for 10: live or current processing-time status, per-transaction-type timing data, any status page or dashboard showing actual backlog or delays, independent corroboration.
